doc: sensitivity_step = 0.3 (read from GenParams, not a constant): the central difference is over +-0.3. Pipeline dtypes; the division by 0.6 sets the amplification of the float32 roundings, hence the measured tolerance. Arguments: s, fine, thr, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads plus sensitivity_step. The floor 0.05 is a literal of the source. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 2.4e-9; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 3.5e-8 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 99x the larger of the two spreads.
